title: A Promise for the Summer
author: Theo Coldharbour
blurb: Wendell Dravenmoor, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
